name: Jiangsu Boqian New Materials Stock Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu Boqian New Materials Stock Co., Ltd. research, develops, produces, and sells nanometer metal powder materials in China. The products include pure metal powders, including nickel, copper, copper flake, iron and silver powders; binary alloy powder, such as Cu-Mn, copper-nickel, silver bismuth, nickel chromium, iron cobalt, iron nickel, ferrosilicon, and iron silicon alloy powders; ternary alloy powder, including tin-silver-copper and tin-bismuth-silver alloy powders; and other powders, such as silicon powders, silver-coated copper and nickel powders, and 3D printed metal powders.
